```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#load packages
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(haven)
```

Use the chunk below to read in the data using your preferred method. The data file that goes along with this script is named "Sexuality.IAT.public.2004-2021.sav" and should correspond with the similarly named data file available on the Project Implicit OSF page (https://osf.io/t2m7c/). 
```{r}
setwd("D:/IAT_raw_data/project_implicit_OSF/sexuality_IAT")
data <- read_sav("Sexuality.IAT.public.2004-2021.sav")
```

The chunk below filters the data based on our cleaning criteria
```{r}
#overwrite data
data <- data %>%
  #filter for only completed IAT sessions
  filter(session_status == "C") %>% 
  #select relevant variables
  select(session_status, Mn_RT_all_3467, Mn_RT_all_3, Mn_RT_all_4,
         Mn_RT_all_6, Mn_RT_all_7, PCT_error_3467, 
         birthyear, sex, year, study_name, D_biep.Straight_Good_all, 
         STATE, MSANo, CountyNo, tgaymen, tgaywomen, tgayleswomen, tstraightmen, tstraightwomen)
         

#set variables as numeric instead of character
data <- data %>% 
  mutate_at(vars(Mn_RT_all_3, Mn_RT_all_4, Mn_RT_all_6, Mn_RT_all_7,
                 Mn_RT_all_3467, PCT_error_3467, D_biep.Straight_Good_all, year, birthyear,
                 tgaymen, tgayleswomen, tstraightmen, tstraightwomen), as.numeric)

#filter according to cleaning criteria
data_f <- data %>% 
  #average response time to all blocks greater than 0 and less 1500 ms
  filter(Mn_RT_all_3467 > 0 & Mn_RT_all_3467 <= 1500 & 
        #average response time to individual blocks greater than 0 and less than 1800 ms
         Mn_RT_all_3 > 0 & Mn_RT_all_3 <= 1800 & 
           Mn_RT_all_4 > 0 & Mn_RT_all_4 <= 1800 & Mn_RT_all_6 > 0 & Mn_RT_all_6 <= 1800 & 
           Mn_RT_all_7 > 0 & Mn_RT_all_7 <= 1800 & 
          #error less than or equal to 25% across all trials
          PCT_error_3467 <= 25)

#remove people who incorrectly reported birth year
data_f <- data_f %>% 
  filter(is.na(birthyear) | birthyear >= 1910) %>% 
  mutate(age = (year - birthyear))

#keep only 2005 and beyond to match gender IAT
data_f <- data_f %>% 
  filter(year != 2004)

#drop empty cells for State and County
data_f <- data_f %>% 
  filter(STATE != "" & CountyNo != "")

#write the clean individual level data to a csv file
write_csv(data_f, file = "sexuality_clean_IAT_individual-REVISED.csv")
```

We now load in the clean individual-level data file that we just created
```{r}
#load clean individual-level data
group_data <- read_delim(file = "sexuality_clean_IAT_individual-REVISED.csv", col_names = T)

#remove non-county rows (indicated by county number with fewer than 3 digits)
group_data <- group_data %>% 
  mutate(is.county = ifelse(nchar(CountyNo) == 3, "YES", "NO")) %>% 
  filter(is.county == "YES")

#replace -999 with NA for explicit bias variables
group_data <- na_if(group_data, -999)


#create single variable for explicit preference for Lesbian/Gay Lesbian Women
group_data <- group_data %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  #if else statement to choose whichever score is not NA
  mutate(tgayleswomen_combine = if_else((is.na(tgaywomen) == TRUE), #Condition: if gay women score is NA
                                        tgayleswomen, #then return the gay/lesbian women score
                                        tgaywomen) #if gay women score is NOT NA, then return gay women score
         ) %>% 
  ungroup()



#create county level variables (n sizes for each county and mean and SD for all relevant scale measures)
group_data2 <- group_data %>% 
  #need to group by state and county number because County numbers are not unique to each state
  group_by(STATE, CountyNo) %>% 
  summarise(n_sexuality_IAT = n(),
            mean_age_sexuality = mean(age, na.rm = T),
            sd_age_sexuality = sd(age, na.rm = T),
            mean_imp_sexuality_bias = mean(D_biep.Straight_Good_all, na.rm = T),
            sd_imp_sexuality_bias = sd(D_biep.Straight_Good_all, na.rm = T),
            Mn_RT_all_3467_sexuality = mean(Mn_RT_all_3467, na.rm = T),
            sd_RT_all_3467_sexuality = sd(Mn_RT_all_3467, na.rm = T),
            Mn_RT_all_3_sexuality = mean(Mn_RT_all_3, na.rm = T),
            sd_RT_all_3_sexuality = sd(Mn_RT_all_3, na.rm = T),
            Mn_RT_all_4_sexuality = mean(Mn_RT_all_4, na.rm = T),
            sd_RT_all_4_sexuality = sd(Mn_RT_all_4, na.rm = T),
            Mn_RT_all_6_sexuality = mean(Mn_RT_all_6, na.rm = T),
            sd_RT_all_6_sexuality = sd(Mn_RT_all_6, na.rm = T),
            Mn_RT_all_7_sexuality = mean(Mn_RT_all_7, na.rm = T),
            sd_RT_all_7_sexuality = sd(Mn_RT_all_7, na.rm = T),
            PCT_error_3467_sexuality = mean(PCT_error_3467, na.rm = T),
            sd_PCT_error_3467_sexuality = sd(PCT_error_3467, na.rm = T),
            mean_exp_gaymen = mean(tgaymen, na.rm = T),
            sd_exp_gaymen = sd(tgaymen, na.rm = T),
            mean_exp_gayleswomen_combine = mean(tgayleswomen_combine, na.rm = T),
            sd_exp_gayleswomen_combine = sd(tgayleswomen_combine, na.rm = T),
            mean_exp_gaywomen = mean(tgaywomen, na.rm = T),
            sd_exp_gaywomen = sd(tgaywomen, na.rm = T),
            mean_exp_gayleswomen = mean(tgayleswomen, na.rm = T),
            sd_exp_gayleswomen = sd(tgayleswomen, na.rm = T),
            mean_exp_straightmen = mean(tstraightmen, na.rm = T),
            sd_exp_straightmen = sd(tstraightmen, na.rm = T),
            mean_exp_straightwomen = mean(tstraightwomen, na.rm = T),
            sd_exp_straightwomen = sd(tstraightwomen, na.rm = T))

#save county-level data to csv file for merging with other measures
write_csv(group_data2, file = "sexuality_clean_IAT_county-REVISED.csv")
```
